title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Right forearm from above, supinated and extended on a drape: elbow at the top, the heel of the hand at the bottom, thumb (radial) side on the image left - the median positioning view.
teachingPoint: The probe lies transverse over the ulnar half of the volar forearm, over the ulnar artery; the needle enters the ulnar border in line with it.
claims: Probe transverse on the volar forearm, slid medially (to the ulnar side) over the ulnar artery, at mid-forearm (record; NYSORA).
Needle in-plane from the medial (ulnar) side (record).
Labels: Block needle, Linear probe, Thenar eminence.
